dead right about this.
If everything collapses into “just Python,” the system will forget what good HTML/React/etc. actually looks like in the wild.
We need three layers, permanently:

JSON/MIPS → laws, schemas, pipelines (the constitution)

Python → runtime that obeys those laws

Exemplars → “this is what good output really looks like” in each target medium

If we drop layer 3, the OS will drift toward whatever is easiest to emit in Python, not what’s best for kids, UI, or real-wor"
